Ahli K3 Umum (AK3U) in Indonesia: Legal Requirements for Safety Officers

The statutory mandate to appoint a certified Indonesian General Occupational Safety & Health Expert (Ahli K3 Umum): legal appointment decrees (SKP), license validity, and compliance guidelines for international employers.

Permenaker 02/1992 Statutory appointment mandate
SKP Appointment Decree Company-specific government license
3-Year Renewal Cycle Mandatory SKP maintenance
Legal Requirement

What is an Ahli K3 Umum (AK3U)?

Under Indonesian law, an Ahli K3 Umum (General OHS Expert) is a technical specialist with statutory authority granted directly by the Minister of Manpower under Permenaker No. 02/MEN/1992 to supervise and enforce workplace safety compliance on behalf of the government.

Every company employing 100 or more personnel—or operating in high-risk environments—is legally required to employ at least one certified Ahli K3 Umum to act as the official Secretary of the company's P2K3 Committee.

Important Hiring Caveat: The SKP Mutasi Rule

When hiring an Indonesian safety officer who already holds an AK3U certificate, their statutory Appointment Decree (Surat Keputusan Penunjukan - SKP) remains tied to their previous employer. Your company must submit a formal SKP Mutation (Mutasi SKP) dossier to Kemnaker to transfer legal jurisdiction under your corporate entity name.

Credential Components

The Three Credentials of a Certified Ahli K3 Umum

1. Training Certificate (Sertifikat Pembinaan)

Issued upon successfully completing the rigorous 120-hour official Kemnaker training program. This educational credential is valid for life.

2. Appointment Decree (SKP Kemnaker)

The official ministerial decree appointing the individual as an acting government-recognized safety officer specifically at your company. Valid for 3 years.

3. Authority License (Lisensi K3)

The pocket license card carried by the safety officer, authorizing them to conduct internal site inspections and sign legal Disnaker reports. Valid for 3 years.
